release_requirement: As-built modal model on inspected geometry with installed sensor/bracket/cable mass and measured root restraint; commit its source and this value before any tap record exists

Owner decision recorded before any modal record; distinct from measurement uncertainty (the static protocol uses 0.15 for a different observable; the nominal hand-vs-FEA f1 gap is 0.135 - both are information only)
u_k/k from inspected L/OD/wall tolerances the reviewed material basis and the measured root flexibility from the static campaign
u_m/m from weighed body bracket and moving cable plus the installed accelerometer/cable mass
Weigh the installed sensor and moving cable; enter into the modal mass and its uncertainty rather than assuming negligible
Record the actual rate and anti-aliasing filter; must resolve the predicted f1 with margin
Frequency resolution is 1/T; choose T so the bin width is small against the band half-width and record the actual value
Excite bending away from the root node on both axes; record the measured location
Observe near the tip on both axes; record the measured location
Number of repeats per axis fixed before acquisition; repeatability enters the measurement uncertainty
